exposure: ethnicity (South Asian, Middle East/North African, East Asian, Ethnic European)
outcome: fetal size (estimated fetal weight, head circumference, abdominal circumference, femur length) at gestational weeks 24, 32, 37
fetal growth from mid-pregnancy until birth
cohort: The study included 823 pregnant women and their offspring from the multi-ethnic STORK-Groruddalen study in Oslo, Norway.
finding: Significant ethnic differences in fetal size and body proportions were observed from gestational week 24, and in fetal growth until birth, with variations in growth patterns and birth weight among South Asian, Middle East/North African, and East Asian fetuses compared to Europeans, which were only partly explained by maternal factors.
